title: Neethaane En Ponvasantham
desc: Varun and Nithya's childhood romance is cut short when they pursue different paths in life. Years later, fate reunites them and Varun sets out on a heartfelt journey to win back the love of his life.

title: Namma Veettu Kalyanam
desc: Two sisters, Meena and Sitha, fall in love with two college professors and get married to them, only to find out that their husbands are unemployed and are posing as professors.

title: Veetula Raman Veliyila Krishnan
desc: Rajasekaran, a civil engineer, marries Jayalakshmi and moves to the city. Their peaceful life turns chaotic when their neighbour Subba Rao casts an evil eye on Jayalakshmi.

title: Idhayathai Thirudathe
desc: A terminally ill man decides to live alone on a hill station and falls for a bubbly woman, until he makes a shocking discovery.

title: Autograph
desc: Senthil, an advertising executive, decides to invite his old friends to his wedding. His past is unraveled as he sets out on a journey to meet his old friends and lovers.
